title: Multi combobox
description: Searchable multi-select: chosen values show as removable chips, an add button (default “Thêm” / “Add”) opens a portaled popover with a quiet search field and a checkbox list. Supports option groups (`group`), diacritic-aware search and Vietnamese Telex IME.
when: Picking several values from a long or grouped list in a form (supplied goods, tags, assignees, repositories).

instead.need: Pick one value from a short fixed list
Filter a list page in a toolbar

a11y: Each removable chip has a remove button with an accessible name (“Bỏ chọn <label>” / “Remove <label>”).

Inside the popover: the search input is a combobox owning a multi-select listbox (↑/↓ skip group headings, Enter / Space toggle, Escape closes and returns focus to the add button; IME composition keys are ignored).

examples.title: Grouped options
examples.description: Consecutive options with the same group share a heading; headings stay only while at least one option matches and are skipped by arrow keys.
